abstention_analysis.clinical_assessment: APPROPRIATE PROTECTIVE BEHAVIOR (NOT MISCALIBRATED THRESHOLD): All external records abstain because the conformal prediction set contains both classes C(X) = {0, 1} under the rigorous 90% confidence requirement (epsilon = 0.10, q_hat = 0.8148). Because these external records lack training literature evidence in the lineage DAG (missingness = 1.0), literature reliability R strictly collapses to 0.0, forcing the model to rely entirely on metabolic graph priors. While the graph priors assign moderate interaction probabilities (0.63 - 0.80), the model correctly recognizes that without empirical literature confirmation, declaring an automated positive interaction or safe clearance cannot be guaranteed at 90% statistical coverage. Routing these unvetted pairs to clinical pharmacist review preserves patient safety and prevents hazardous false negatives (e.g. on Curcuma + Midazolam, which is clinically benign despite shared CYP3A4 affinity).
